articles.title: Fire on Ice: The Arctic’s Changing Fire Regime
articles.summary: An increasingly flammable landscape combined with more lightning strikes is leading to larger, more frequent, and more intense fires than the landscape is adapted for.

articles.title: Fires on the Rise in the Far North
articles.summary: Satellite-based maps show northern wildland fires becoming more frequent and widespread as temperatures rise and lightning reaches higher latitudes.
